title: eval metrics warns when --repo matches no events
prompt: Update `clawsub eval metrics` so that when `--repo <name>` is passed but zero events in the log match that repo, it prints a warning to stderr: `warning: no events for repo <name>`. Currently it exits 0 with no output. The exit code must remain 0 (this is a warning, not an error). Add a unit test covering the warning path.
acceptanceCriteria: clawsub eval metrics --repo <name> prints a warning to stderr when no events match
exit code is 0 (warning, not an error)
normal output is unaffected when --repo does match events
unit test covers the warning case
